verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU, NPU, memory subsystem). User-defined event-triggered automation rules belong to operating systems or software products, so this story is a category error for a chip. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships any rules or automation engine; the AI Hub and SDK material covers model optimization and deployment, not event automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
